verdict.rationale: Deel doesn't show a native in-app AI insights/copilot feature, but its MCP server exposes tools like calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts that let connected AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT) generate cost comparisons and suggestions from live contract/payroll data, which partially satisfies the 'AI-generated insights from my data' story via an external-agent path rather than an in-product feature. Missing for 10: evidence of a built-in AI insights dashboard/copilot inside the Deel UI itself, and independent confirmation that MCP-derived insights are actually surfaced back into the product experience.
